title: billing.account_changed
description: Changed is published by billing every time something of a user's account that the clients show changes: the points balance and its history (a purchase confirmed, points spent or given back by a boost), the boosts the user holds, or the purchases. It carries no data, only what to ask for again, so a repeated or out-of-order delivery is harmless. Premium has its own signed snapshot, billing.premium_updated. It is not signed: the worst a forged one can do is make a screen ask again for what it already shows.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

user_id.description: Usuario al que se le avisa (ID de discordia-identify).

resource.description: Qué volver a pedir: el saldo de puntos, los boosts del usuario o sus compras.
